correctness.rationale: PASS: Deleted-product cubical Conf2(K5) has exactly 20 zero cells, 60 one cells and 30 squares and satisfies the two-point Abrams deformation-retract criterion. Vertex links are six-cycles, each edge has two incident squares, and its connected closed surface admits an integral signed top cycle with all 30 square coefficients ±1; Euler characteristic −10 gives orientable genus six, homology ranks 1,12,1. Independent exact signed action computation matched the proposed H1 and H2 characters for all 5!*2=240 elements. The H1 S5 character is two copies of wedge² standard character (f−1)(f−2)/2−t with swap trace zero, and H2 orientation character is sgn(sigma)*(-1)^swap. Standard semisimplicity yields two six-dimensional irreducible swap eigenspaces; orientation reversal forces the intersection form to vanish on each, making Lagrangian subspaces. The freely reversing swap quotient is a nonorientable genus-seven surface.
